verdict.rationale: Password-protecting a deployed site is a fair question for a hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of a built-in way to gate a Worker or site behind a password or login. The generic mention of "Zero Trust controls" built into the network is an adjacent claim that never describes protecting a deployed site, and the API-token docs cover access to Cloudflare's own API, not visitor access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system
